essence: One should first perform all the mātṛkā placements.
One should recite the Veda and the Gāyatrī again.
The mantra includes the formulas pārayānavya and pāraya.
The verse is the root preceded by Gāyatrī, containing durjuhoti and yajanājinam.
One must first consider the specific desire.
